title: How to apply for a study abroad scholarship

scenes.say: Planning to apply for a study abroad scholarship? Keep these documents ready.

items: Check eligibility on the official website
Many close almost a year before the course starts
scenes.say: Step one. Start early. Pick your scholarship and course, and check eligibility on the official website. Many applications close almost a year before the course starts.

Step two. Your documents. Passport, degree certificate and marksheets, an IELTS or TOEFL score if asked, your statement of purpose or essays, two or three recommendation letters, and your C V with work experience letters.

items: Admission letter from the university abroad
scenes.say: For government schemes like the National Overseas Scholarship, also keep your income certificate, caste certificate if applicable, and the admission letter from the university abroad.

items: Apply only on the official website
Then the university offer and visa
scenes.say: Step four. Apply only on the official website, and get ready for the interview. After selection comes the university offer and the visa.
Official links are in the description. Find the full guide free on Marg Disha dot com.
